description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Submit a result. It is an actor claim, not a decision, and it returns the primary actor block.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

content.description: The text to record. It is stored as an actor claim, never as established fact.

matter_id.description: Id of the matter you are admitted to (returned by atlas.bind_actor). Optional when you are bound to exactly one matter.

name: atlas.submit_result
title: Submit result
